描述_EN: while the wares produced at the yaozhou kiln complex enjoyed popularity from the end of the tang dynasty (618-906) through to the beginning of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368), these bowls exhibit the olive green glaze and dense surface designs common to the yaozhou wares of the northern song period. carving was an important design method in yaozhou wares. angled tools were used to carve out the stylised waves and duck motif in sloping grooves, and comb-like tools provided the linear accents visible in the waves. the celadon glaze was then applied to the bowl, pooling in the crevices and laying thinly on raised areas. through firing, the pooled areas grew darker in colour, and the thinly glazed areas more transparent, creating the illusion of light and shadows in the surface design. these bowls are examples of the yaozhou wares typical of the northern song dynasty (960-1127). the dish on the far right would have began with a smooth body, partially dried (or ‘leather hard’).
描述_ZN: 从唐朝末年（618-906）到元朝初年（1279-1368），耀州窑群生产的瓷器都很受欢迎，这些碗表现出北宋时期耀州瓷器常见的橄榄绿釉和密集的表面图案。 雕花是耀州器物的重要设计方法。 角形工具被用来在倾斜的凹槽中雕刻出风格化的波浪和鸭子图案，而梳状工具则提供了波浪中可见的线性点缀。 然后将青瓷釉涂在碗上，在缝隙中积聚，在凸起的地方薄薄地铺上。 通过烧制，汇集的区域颜色越来越深，薄薄的釉面区域越来越透明，在表面设计中创造了光和影的幻觉。 这些碗是北宋时期（960-1127）典型的耀州器物的例子。 最右边的盘子开始时应该是光滑的器身，部分干燥（或 "皮革硬"）。
